final_message.text:
I have successfully fixed and updated the source code of the `inventory` package so that all requirements specified in the docstrings are met and the entire test suite passes.

### Summary of Changes:
- **`workspace/inventory/pricing.py`**:
  - Updated `parse_price` to correctly strip thousands separators (commas) and handle accounting-style negative prices enclosed in parentheses (e.g. `(12.00)` -> `-12.00`).
  - Updated `apply_discount` to round to 2 decimal places using `ROUND_HALF_UP` (commercial round half up rule).
- **`workspace/inventory/report.py`**:
  - Fixed `low_stock` to check for quantities strictly below the threshold (`< threshold`) and sort item names alphabetically, ignoring case.
- **`workspace/inventory/export.py`**:
  - Updated `to_csv_row` to properly escape names containing commas or double quotes according to RFC 4180 (wrapping in double quotes and escaping inner double quotes).
- **`workspace/tests/test_extras.py`** *(Created new test file)*:
  - Added comprehensive test coverage for all edge cases specified in the docstrings.
